checks.message: This package is available for conceptual review only. The site and key-area geometry remains provisional; official boundary and control data are pending; all derived geometry, metrics, figures, and reports require recalculation once those data are supplied. Eligibility, scoring, and formal acceptance remain maintainer decisions.
All three required key areas are present and explicitly marked as provisional rough constraints; station and road anchoring remains pending official data.
Five proposal land-use polygons share cut lines and completely partition the submitted provisional site without gaps or overlaps.
Twelve scenario nodes are present, including three industrial testing and validation scenarios, each requiring human takeover and a non-AI equivalent.

Chinese and English Markdown, rendered HTML, offline visual HTML, five figures, and A3/A0 PDFs are paired in the manifest with aligned sections, claims, metrics, evidence references, and figure positions.
Both visual HTML files are static, offline, responsive, and contain no remote resources, scripts, frames, forms, tracking, or map tiles.
The bilingual proposal and matrices cover mandatory standards, all 15 design-depth items, all announcement and Agent requirements, geometry, metrics, sources, assumptions, and recalculation triggers.
All 40 package files are listed once, all non-manifest SHA-256 values match disk contents, and no package file is unlisted.
